reason: My Fresha page and Instagram already bring the bookings in, and I knocked up the Wix bit myself. Paying nothing upfront is nice, but I'd still be signing up for £43 a month forever plus someone pushing £325 SEO at me, for a problem I don't really feel I've got.
objection: It's the monthly bills after launch. One more subscription on top of Fresha and Wix, from a bloke in Kuwait I can't pop round to if it breaks, and no UK clients to ask about him.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing proof it brings in more bookings than my Fresha page does, like a local Manchester business similar to mine showing the numbers, and a care plan I can cancel any month or skip completely.
